text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2003456789 — elevated egress errors detected from eu-west4 zone-c (network drop ~12%, increased 5xxs). Paging oncall.
raj: got the alert, looking into BGP flaps reported by our edge peers. attaching initial graphs.
raj: graph link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/edges/egress-errors?var=region:eu-west4
sara: i'm oncall, joining. any customer impact observed yet?
mike: internal metrics show retries spiking for models behind eu-west4. latency up ~200ms p95, error rate 5xx -> 4.8% for last 5m.
leah: support queue showing ~14 customer tickets referencing image generation failures from EU. flagging support for comms @natascha-support.
natascha-support: acknowledged, preparing holding notice. will wait for confirmed severity before sending customer message.
raj: looks like partial egress path saturation from zone-c to our peering partner; prefix flapping. working w/ netops to escalate to carrier.
sara: can we fail traffic to eu-central1 for affected routes temporarily? what's the risk for stateful sessions?
mike: can do per-route reroute for stateless API traffic. for chat/generation we can switch model routing to eu-central1 fallback pool. risk: cold caches, slight latency bump.
leah: runbook: ENG-REROUTE-01. steps. paste below.
leah: ```
# quick runbook snippets
1) update routing policy: /infra/router/update-policy --region eu-west4 --zone zone-c --action divert --to eu-central1 --weight 100
2) update model-router: POST /admin/model-routing {"from_region":"eu-west4","to_region":"eu-central1","scope":"stateless","ttl":300}
3) notify status page and customers
``` 
raj: executing step 1 now, applying route divert to eu-central1. will monitor BGP state and packet loss.
ops-bot: deploy started: routing-policy-change (id: rp-2003) by raj
raj: applied. immediate drop in 5xxs from 4.8% -> 2.1% within 90s. p95 latency reduced ~80ms.
sara: good. prepare status page update (draft below) and internal comms for SRE/Support.
leah: status page draft:
leah: "We are investigating elevated errors for requests served from eu-west4 (zone-c). Traffic is being diverted to eu-central1 to mitigate customer impact. Some requests may see increased latency while caches warm. Engineers are working with our network provider to restore normal egress paths. Status: Partial degradation — Mitigation in progress."
natascha-support: customer notification template (short):
natascha-support: "We're currently experiencing degraded service for requests originating in eu-west4. We've routed traffic to a healthy region to reduce errors. You may see slightly higher latency for a short period. No data loss. We'll update once the original paths are restored. — Redwood Inference Status Team"
mike: internal comms (oncall -> eng-sre):
mike: "Action taken: diverted traffic from eu-west4 zone-c -> eu-central1. Root cause: edge egress path instability (carrier peering). Mitigation: route diversion deployed rp-2003, observing improved error rates. Next: carrier escalation and monitor. Follow up: rollback once carrier confirms stable prefixes."
raj: carrier responded: investigating under ticket #CARR-8921, they see a partial configuration sync issue. ETA unknown.
sara: ok, set severity to Sev2 (customer-facing but mitigated). posting to status page now. @natascha-support please send out the customer notice after I post.
ops-bot: status-page update posted (id: sp-8892) — Partial degradation for eu-west4; mitigation in progress.
natascha-support: sent customer blast to affected accounts list. small batch for enterprise customers first, then broader bulletin. included support contact and blameless link.
leah: logging follow-up tasks: create incident ticket INC-2003, assign to raj/mike for next 48h, include RCA timeline.
mike: quick verification: run a smoke curl to model endpoint routed to eu-central1
mike: ```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","input":"hello"}'
```
mike: response fine, 200, latency ~120ms from our synthetic agent in eu-west.
sara: good. keep monitoring dashboards for 30m, then re-evaluate rollback possibility. raj please keep carrier ticket updated and paste carrier ticket link here.
raj: carrier ticket: https://carrier.portal/CARR-8921 — updated with our logs.
natascha-support: support queue triage: created ticket bundle and set priority to P2; added customer-facing note linking status page sp-8892.
leah: postmortem template note to capture: timeline, mitigation timeline, routing policy id, carrier ticket id, customer impact summary, follow-ups (monitoring improvements, automated reroute test plan).
sara: moving to handoff in 20m. next oncall will monitor overnight. handoff checklist:
leah: - confirm rp-2003 stays active until carrier declares stable
leah: - monitor p95 and 5xx for eu-west4 for 1h
leah: - collect packet captures if carrier requests
leah: - prepare rollback command if divert causes unforeseen issues
mike: rollback snippet:
mike: ```
/infra/router/update-policy --region eu-west4 --zone zone-c --action remove-divert --id rp-2003
POST /admin/model-routing {"action":"rollback","id":"mr-2003"}
```
raj: current status: errors steady at ~1.8%, healthy trend. carrier still investigating. will update every 30m.
leah: thanks all. tagging incident channel for visibility. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2003456789 — thread moved to incident-status-log. final update pending RCA.
